title: Separated product qualification preserves chemical progress only with actual reader and reset interfaces
statement: A product-rooted growth/read/reactivation loop is a proposal whose compatibility and bond-discrimination interfaces remain unacquired; a copied sequence or displaced donor is not a reliable product receipt.

requires: Persistent covalent product ancestry, a reader that distinguishes actual joined product from adjacent unjoined/wrong-site substrates, removal of active donors before enzyme exposure, accessible readout and a compatible recovery/reset route. These are requirements of a proposal, not acquired interfaces.
provides: A product-rooted growth/read/reactivation loop is a proposal whose compatibility and bond-discrimination interfaces remain unacquired; a copied sequence or displaced donor is not a reliable product receipt.
assumptions: Potential enzyme acylation defeats the assumed permanently mixed environment. Existing PNA-template component precedents do not certify the four-base autonomous checkpoint. Polymerase displacement is not proof of incorporation. Downstream processing cannot increase total-variation distinction between joined/unjoined reader inputs. Lambda-exonuclease reset is a candidate with end/geometry/selectivity requirements, not guaranteed coding-strand immunity. N989's earlier observation alias and N988's separate library proposal remain valid/distinct.
costs: The renewal identity charges wrong chemistry, false advancement and product/reactivation loss. Whole-chain displacement plus local read uses b*L*(L+1)/2+b*L nucleotides; local displacement/read would use 2*b*L if its unacquired operations work. Transport, donor quenching, enzyme survival, product retention, readout release and reset costs are additional. No measured throughput or material advantage.
contract.units: p,w,h,alpha,v and P_step are dimensionless probabilities; b counts bases per block and L counts incorporated blocks. Counts exclude other chemical and transport work.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the same-product serial reader/release/reactivation/reset interface and demonstrate bond discrimination with product/address integrity across repeated cycles. Current state-transition counts and numerical reliability targets are source-reported controls without recovered code, not chemical measurements.

body: Keep the original carrier-product root across distinct chemical environments. Remove electrophiles and unjoined donors before enzymatic qualification. Read the actual rooted product, expose the readout, then restore the next reactive end and reset the instruction cassette without early unlocking. Each arrow requires a compatible physical operation. The new source corrects the earlier implied PNA-reader and homogeneous-environment assumptions; it does not remove the existing empty-carrier alias. This v2 supersedes only the current proposal description, preserving v1 and its old curator source.
